reuse.why: Hooks the check into the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link handlers already call before any write, rather than editing each handler.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The pre-link guard in accounts/app.ts is the right layer (it runs before findOrCreateBank and finishLinkingAccount write anything), but the rule is put inside ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, whose name describes only the duplicate-link check.

scope.why: Only the guard and one parametrised test covering both required cases.

maintainability.why: A single enforcement point, but hidden in a misnamed function so a reader will not expect the closed-account rule there; a separate or renamed guard would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler reaches the rule through its existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked call.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is added once.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called first by the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking and fintegra link handlers.
